title: Top NBA Draft pick Dybantsa to miss opener with ankle sprain
summary: A.J. Dybantsa, the top pick in this year's NBA Draft, will miss Washington's season opener Wednesday against visiting Milwaukee with a left ankle sprain, Wizards coach Brian Keefe said.
